name: FOV Email Finder and Verifier
description: Email finder and verifier API for finding professional email addresses, verifying email deliverability, and searching emails by domain.
use_when: Use when the user wants to find or verify an email address, enrich a lead, or discover emails for a company domain.
how_to_call: Read openapi_url, build the target URL from x402.http_base_url plus the OpenAPI path, then call BRIJ MCP tool brij_pay.
